comment: Verbatim transcription from the arXiv v5 PDF (fetched 2026-08-31). Model: minimal QET Hamiltonian H_tot = H_0 + H_1 + V with H_n = h Z_n + h^2/sqrt(h^2+k^2) (Eq. 2) and V = 2k X_0 X_1 + 2k^2/sqrt(h^2+k^2) (Eq. 3). Gate angles are functions of (h,k), not free parameters: ground-state preparation angle theta = -arccos(sqrt((1 - h/sqrt(h^2+k^2))/2)) (Eq. 7); Bob's conditional rotation U_1(mu) = R_Y(2*mu*phi) (Eq. 10) with cos(2phi) = (h^2+2k^2)/sqrt((h^2+2k^2)^2 + h^2 k^2) (Eq. 11), sin(2phi) = hk/sqrt((h^2+2k^2)^2 + h^2 k^2) (Eq. 12); compute them in code (vacuum.qet), never store derived numbers here. Fig. 2(B) bar-label probabilities were added on 2026-09-01 from a 400-dpi render (fig2B_* quantities), together with Table I's (h,k)=(1,1) ibm_cairo and qasm_simulator rows (ibm_cairo_*, qasm_* value/error pairs). The readout estimators behind Tables I-II are those of the author's public code (Ref. [16], github.com/IKEDAKAZUKI/Quantum-Energy-Teleportation, QET.py): <H1> = h^2/s + h<Z1> (Eq. A5), <V> = 2k^2/s + 2k<X0 X1> (Eq. A6), <E0> = h^2/s + h<X0> with X0 read after Alice's Hadamard, bit strings in qiskit c1c0 order. Note: the Fig. 2(B) raw bars imply <V> = -0.152 and <H1> = 0.280 whereas Table I's ibm_cairo unmitigated row prints -0.1733 and 0.2630 — the figure and the table are different runs of the same circuits.
